svg.title: Lymphoid progenitor
svg.desc: Small round common lymphoid progenitor with a large nucleus and light-blue cytoplasmic rim. Biological basis: Early lymphoid progenitors retain a high nucleus-to-cytoplasm ratio and lack the lineage-specific granules of mature leukocytes.
